technique_name: Describe a historic event in detail.
description: The October Revolution, also known as the Bolshevik Revolution, was the second phase of the Russian revolution of 1917. Led by the Bolshevik Party, it started on October 23rd and overthrew the provisional government. The provisional government had been weakened by a series of military defeats and popular discontent with the war.
